mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAM (id, name, rank, upper_team_id) VALUES (NEXT VALUE FOR team_table_sequence, #{name}, #{rank}, #{upperTeamId})
mapper.select: SELECT t1.id , t1.name , t1.rank , t1.upper_team_id , t2.name As upperTeamName FROM team t1 LEFT JOIN team t2 ON t1.upper_team_id = t2.id WHERE t1.id = #{id}
